newsitem.title: USA: Delhi completes Pinnacle Reef expansion.
newsitem.headline: Delhi completes Pinnacle Reef expansion.

text.p: USX-Delhi Group said Monday Delhi Gas Pipeline Corp completed Phase Two of its East Texas Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef expansion program.

This phase adds over 275 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of incremental natural gas gathering and treating capacity to Delhi's existing capacity in the Pinnacle Reef natural gas play of East Texas.
Phase One of the expansion, completed in September 1996, added 100 mmcfd of capacity to the 60 mmcfd built in late 1995.
Phase Two cost about $42 million, the company said.
"Completion of Phase Two of Delhi's ongoing Pinnacle Reef expansion program will result in a significant increase in our flow rates," said David M. Kihneman, president of Delhi.
"All 19 of the Pinnacle Reef wells completed to date are connected to Delhi's gathering and treating facilities."
He noted current Reef production has increased to about 200 million cubic feet daily from a December 1996 average of about 133 million.

"Based on expected drilling activity, volumes gathered and treated by Delhi could increase to as high as 300 (million cubic feet per day) by the end of this year. Our Phase Two expansion program will allow us to accommodate these additional volumes, as well as to participate in the continuing development of (natural) gas reserves in the Smackover trends along our extensive East Texas pipeline system. And, we already have Phase Three on the drawing board," Kihneman said.

Delhi said the expansion, which began in December 1995, included construction of 92 miles of 20-inch diameter pipeline, an increase in the inlet flow capacity of the company's Aker and Teague treating facilities and the installation of 8,000 compressor horsepower.
USX-Delhi, a unit of USX Corp, includes Delhi Gas Pipeline and related subsidiaries of USX.
